name: Constantine
one_line: The man handed the crown at the end, whom almost nobody remembers.
dossier: In both Geoffrey and Malory, Arthur gives the kingdom to Constantine, his kinsman, before he is carried away. It is a small detail with a large implication: the succession is completed. Whatever Avalon is, the realm has been formally handed on, and the government of Britain proceeds — which sits oddly beside the promise that Arthur will return to it.
